name: S.O.R.N.
description:
About This Game

S.O.R.N. is a 3rd-person mecha action shooter with fast paced combat and lots of customization. Play as J-12, a mech pilot for the PMC Haven, through three missions unraveling the mysteries of the organization.

  • Intense mecha action gameplay

  • 3 cinematic campaign missions

  • At least 1 side mission

  • Fully voice acted cutscenes

  • 15 interchangeable parts

  • 6 unique weapons

  • Full color customization

In S.O.R.N., your mech is decked out with offensive and defensive options that you'll need to push to their fullest to succeed. With a weapon in each hand and a missile launcher on your back you can shred through swarms of enemies, and when things get desperate use your melee to cut foes into pieces! You can glide and fly to quickly move around the large levels and use your dash to get out of immediate danger. Your weapons will automatically lock onto enemies so you can focus on dodging and blowing stuff up!

Customize your mech with distinct parts and weapons to fit how you want to play. Each body part changes your speed, hull, energy, and melee damage. All the unlockable weapons have unique strengths and functions, so mix and match weapons to find a combo that perfectly fits your playstyle.

  • MINIGUN
    A famous assault of lead upon your enemy with a huge magazine. If a bullet doesn't hit your target, it'll hit something near it anyways.

  • CANON
    High fire power with a small magazine. It pairs perfectly with any other weapon for it's quick reload and fast projectiles.

  • LASER
    A steady stream of destruction focused on your enemies. There's nothing in the world that can dodge the speed of light!

  • SHOTGUN
    A massive scatter of projectiles in every shot. Up close, you can do insane damage instantly.

  • RAILGUN
    Charge up the gun to unleash a devastating bolt that pierces enemies. Hold it down for as long as you want then release when your enemies are lined up!

  • PISTOL
    Charge up your shot and if you release within a tight window you can land massive damage. No one can agree on how it works, but everyone agrees it's their favorite weapon.

What are you doing down here? What are you waiting for? The game is free! It's only 2 GB! Get out there, learn the truth of Haven, and fight for the world!
short_desc: Glide, fly, and blast your way through Haven's facilities to discover the truth while facing friends and foes of your past along the way.
